events.label: founding
events.text: Chicago Auditorium Association incorporated by Ferdinand Peck to develop the theater.

evidence.quote: incorporated the Chicago Auditorium Association in December 1886

events.text: President Grover Cleveland laid the cornerstone of the building.

evidence.quote: On October 5 , 1887 , President Grover Cleveland laid the cornerstone for the Auditorium Building

events.text: Building completed; tallest building in the city at the time.
President Benjamin Harrison dedicated the building; Adelina Patti sang at opening.

evidence.quote: On December 9 , 1889 , President Benjamin Harrison dedicated the building

events.text: An addition of 136 offices was housed in the building.
Chicago Symphony Orchestra debuted and made the theatre its home.

evidence.quote: The Chicago Symphony Orchestra debuted on October 16 , 1891

events.text: Chicago Symphony Orchestra moved out of the theatre to Orchestra Hall.

evidence.quote: until moving to Orchestra Hall in 1904

events.text: Opera company renting the accommodation moved to the Civic Opera House.

evidence.quote: moved to the Civic Opera House in 1929

events.text: City of Chicago took over the building as a WWII servicemen's center.

evidence.quote: In 1941 , it was taken over by the city of Chicago

events.text: Roosevelt University moved into the Auditorium Building.

evidence.quote: By 1946 , Roosevelt University moved into the Auditorium Building

events.text: Auditorium Building became part of Roosevelt University.

evidence.quote: Since 1947 , the Auditorium Building has been part of Roosevelt University

events.text: Congress Parkway widened; ground-floor rooms removed for a sidewalk arcade.

evidence.quote: On October 31 , 1967 , the Auditorium Theatre reopened

events.label: landmark_designation
events.text: Building added to the National Register of Historic Places.

evidence.quote: The building was added to the National Register of Historic Places on April 17 , 1970

events.label: landmark_designation
events.text: Building declared a National Historic Landmark.

evidence.quote: It was declared a National Historic Landmark in 1975
It was declared a National Historic Landmark by the U.S . Department of the Interior in 1975
designated a Chicago Landmark on September 15 , 1976

events.text: Major restoration of the Auditorium Theatre begun by Daniel P. Coffey and Associates.

evidence.quote: In 2001 , a major restoration of the Auditorium Theatre was begun

undated_mentions: Auditorium Theatre closed during the Great Depression
